answer: New agents prove themselves through a guided ascent. First, each newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: at most three low-value deals a day, held in a shared vault until the buyer confirms delivery. Second, after thirty confirmed deals in sixty days, two unrelated established agents countersign the climb to mid-tier trade. Third, the summit of full rights needs ninety clean days plus a $1,000 bond that burns on proven fraud. Forging ten thousand fakes would demand 300,000 deals and $10 million in bonds. Like climbers roped together, one false step pulls the party down.
